package moba

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/sync/lockstep"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/sync/nettransport"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

// 传输记录器只替代网络，Match、编码器、追帧和客户端 FrameAssembler 都是正式框架。
// 真实网络另外执行框架的 KCP / TCP 端到端门禁，不把这份记录器称为网络验收。
type relay struct {
	mu      sync.Mutex
	packets map[nettransport.SessionID][][]byte
}

func (r *relay) SendDatagram(_ context.Context, id nettransport.SessionID, raw []byte) error {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	r.packets[id] = append(r.packets[id], append([]byte(nil), raw...))
	return nil
}
func (r *relay) SendReliable(ctx context.Context, id nettransport.SessionID, raw []byte) error {
	return r.SendDatagram(ctx, id, raw)
}
func (r *relay) take(id nettransport.SessionID) [][]byte {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	raw := r.packets[id]
	delete(r.packets, id)
	return raw
}
func newMatch(t *testing.T, configure ...func(*lockstep.MatchConfig)) (*lockstep.Match, *relay) {
	t.Helper()
	r := &relay{packets: map[nettransport.SessionID][][]byte{}}
	cfg := lockstep.MatchConfig{Sequencer: lockstep.SequencerConfig{Players: []lockstep.PlayerID{1, 2}, SubmitWindow: 8, MaxInputBytes: 3}, Datagrams: r, Reliable: r, CatchupBatchFrames: 8, CatchupSendWait: 100 * time.Millisecond}
	for _, apply := range configure {
		apply(&cfg)
	}
	m, err := lockstep.NewMatch(cfg)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(m.Close)
	for i := range 2 {
		if err := m.Attach(lockstep.PlayerID(i+1), nettransport.SessionID(101+i)); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	return m, r
}
func applyPackets(t *testing.T, s *State, a *lockstep.FrameAssembler, packets [][]byte) {
	t.Helper()
	for _, raw := range packets {
		frames, err := a.Ingest(raw)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		for _, frame := range frames {
			if err := s.Apply(frame); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
		}
	}
}
func duelInput(frame lockstep.FrameID, seat int) []byte {
	if frame <= 5 {
		step := int8(1)
		if seat == 1 {
			step = -1
		}
		return Encode(Command{Action: Move, Step: step})
	}
	action := Attack
	if frame%4 == 0 {
		action = Cast
	}
	return Encode(Command{Action: action, Target: HeroTarget})
}
func TestMOBAInputIdentityReplayAndWindow(t *testing.T) {
	m, _ := newMatch(t)
	ctx := context.Background()
	move := Encode(Command{Action: Move, Step: 1})
	if err := Submit(m, 101, 1, move); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	first, err := m.Tick(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(first.Inputs) != 1 {
		t.Fatal("input not sequenced")
	}
	if err := Submit(m, 101, 1, move); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	next, err := m.Tick(ctx)
	if err != nil || len(next.Inputs) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("replay repeated movement")
	}
	if err := Submit(m, 999, 3, move); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("unbound session admitted")
	}
	if err := Submit(m, 101, 30, move); !errors.Is(err, lockstep.ErrFrameTooEarly) {
		t.Fatalf("future frame: %v", err)
	}
	if err := Submit(m, 101, 3, []byte{99, 0, 0}); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("opaque framework bytes bypassed business validation")
	}
	if err := m.Attach(1, 111); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := Submit(m, 101, 3, move); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("old connection still controls seat")
	}
	if err := Submit(m, 111, 3, move); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for range 5 {
		if _, err := m.Tick(ctx); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	if err := Submit(m, 111, 1, move); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("old input exceeded business lateness bound")
	}
}
func TestMOBADeterministicDuelHealsLostBroadcasts(t *testing.T) {
	m, r := newMatch(t)
	server, client := NewState(), NewState()
	a := lockstep.NewFrameAssembler(128)
	for id := lockstep.FrameID(1); id <= 80; id++ {
		// 逆序到达，正式 Sequencer 仍按座位排序；不是 map 遍历决定交互先后。
		for seat := 1; seat >= 0; seat-- {
			if err := Submit(m, uint64(101+seat), id, duelInput(id, seat)); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
		}
		frame, err := m.Tick(context.Background())
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := server.Apply(frame); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		packets := r.take(101)
		r.take(102)
		if id == 4 || id == 5 {
			continue
		}
		applyPackets(t, client, a, packets)
		applyPackets(t, client, a, packets)
	}
	if client.Tick != 80 || server.Digest() != client.Digest() || a.Duplicates() == 0 {
		t.Fatal("redundancy or deterministic simulation diverged")
	}
	if server.Heroes[0].Kills+server.Heroes[1].Kills == 0 {
		t.Fatal("duel never exercised death / respawn")
	}
}
func TestMOBACatchupAndSpectatorCannotControlHeroes(t *testing.T) {
	m, r := newMatch(t)
	ctx := context.Background()
	server, client := NewState(), NewState()
	a := lockstep.NewFrameAssembler(128)
	if err := m.AttachSpectator(700); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := m.HandleCommand(700, lockstep.Command{Operation: lockstep.OpInput, Frame: 1, Payload: Encode(Command{})}); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("spectator controlled hero")
	}
	for id := lockstep.FrameID(1); id <= 25; id++ {
		frame, err := m.Tick(ctx)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := server.Apply(frame); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		packets := r.take(101)
		r.take(102)
		r.take(700)
		if id <= 4 {
			applyPackets(t, client, a, packets)
		}
	}
	if err := m.Attach(1, 201); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := m.StartCatchup(1, a.Next()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for range 15 {
		frame, err := m.Tick(ctx)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := server.Apply(frame); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		applyPackets(t, client, a, r.take(201))
		r.take(102)
		r.take(700)
		if !m.CatchingUp(1) && a.Next() == m.NextFrame() {
			break
		}
	}
	if m.CatchingUp(1) || client.Digest() != server.Digest() {
		t.Fatal("reconnected hero did not reach reference head")
	}
}
func TestMOBAHistoryExpiryAndDesyncAreExplicit(t *testing.T) {
	var verdicts []lockstep.DesyncVerdict
	m, r := newMatch(t, func(c *lockstep.MatchConfig) {
		c.HistoryRetainFrames = lockstep.MinHistoryRetainFrames
		c.OnDesync = func(v lockstep.DesyncVerdict) { verdicts = append(verdicts, v) }
	})
	for range lockstep.MinHistoryRetainFrames + 5 {
		if _, err := m.Tick(context.Background()); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		r.take(101)
		r.take(102)
	}
	if err := m.StartCatchup(1, 1); !errors.Is(err, lockstep.ErrCatchupUnservable) {
		t.Fatalf("trimmed history accepted: %v", err)
	}
	id := m.NextFrame() - 1
	if err := m.ReportHash(1, id, 1); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := m.ReportHash(2, id, 2); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(verdicts) == 0 || !verdicts[len(verdicts)-1].NoMajority {
		t.Fatal("two-seat disagreement produced no explicit no-majority verdict")
	}
}
func TestMOBALaneTowersBaseAndServerResult(t *testing.T) {
	state := NewState()
	if _, _, err := state.Result(); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("unfinished round produced a settlement")
	}
	for id := lockstep.FrameID(1); id <= 100 && !state.Ended; id++ {
		h := state.Heroes[0]
		c := Command{}
		if h.X < 7 {
			c = Command{Action: Move, Step: 1}
		} else if state.Towers[1] > 0 {
			c = Command{Action: Attack, Target: TowerTarget}
		} else if h.X < 9 {
			c = Command{Action: Move, Step: 1}
		} else {
			c = Command{Action: Attack, Target: BaseTarget}
		}
		if err := state.Apply(lockstep.Frame{ID: id, Inputs: []lockstep.Input{{Player: 1, Payload: Encode(c)}}}); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	winner, digest, err := state.Result()
	if err != nil || winner != 1 || len(digest) != 64 || state.Bases[1] != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("reference result: winner=%d err=%v state=%+v", winner, err, state)
	}
	if state.Heroes[0].Gold == 0 {
		t.Fatal("tower destruction never affected battle economy")
	}
	if err := state.Apply(lockstep.Frame{ID: state.Tick + 1}); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("ended simulation kept accepting frames")
	}
}
func TestMOBASkillCooldownShopAndCheckpoint(t *testing.T) {
	s := NewState()
	s.Heroes[0].X = 5
	s.Heroes[1].X = 5
	strike := func(id lockstep.FrameID, action byte) {
		t.Helper()
		if err := s.Apply(lockstep.Frame{ID: id, Inputs: []lockstep.Input{{Player: 1, Payload: Encode(Command{Action: action})}}}); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	strike(1, Cast)
	strike(2, Cast)
	if s.Heroes[0].Mana != 15 || s.Heroes[1].HP != 75 {
		t.Fatal("cooldown did not reject a second cast")
	}
	s.Heroes[0].Gold = 5
	s.Heroes[0].HP = 50
	strike(3, Buy)
	if s.Heroes[0].Gold != 0 || s.Heroes[0].HP != 70 {
		t.Fatal("shop violated cost / heal")
	}
	restored, err := Restore(s.Snapshot())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for id := lockstep.FrameID(4); id <= 20; id++ {
		frame := lockstep.Frame{ID: id}
		if err := s.Apply(frame); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := restored.Apply(frame); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	if s.Digest() != restored.Digest() {
		t.Fatal("checkpoint did not preserve the whole simulation")
	}
	before := s.Digest()
	if err := s.Apply(lockstep.Frame{ID: s.Tick + 1, Inputs: []lockstep.Input{{Player: 1, Payload: []byte{0, 0, 0}}, {Player: 2, Payload: []byte{9}}}}); err == nil || s.Digest() != before {
		t.Fatal("bad later input partially applied the frame")
	}
	if _, err := Restore([]byte(`{"Version":99}`)); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("foreign checkpoint version accepted")
	}
}
